record.label: Electron interactions on the real-space grid
record.statement: The circuit Fourier transforms the electrons to a real-space grid to apply the electron–proton, electron–projectile and electron–electron interactions. For the short-range part, it uses Pauli exclusion to reduce the contribution to the LCU coefficient 1-norm $\lambda$.
record.boundary: The cited identity establishes the occupation formula for the selected short-range term. The cutoff at 1.4 Ha and the effect of the range separation on $\lambda$ are reported in Appendix G.3.
